questions.question: When does Fall 2025 registration begin?
questions.gold_answer: Fall 2025 registration begins March 17, 2025.

questions.question: When does Fall 2026 registration begin?
questions.gold_answer: Fall 2026 registration begins March 23, 2026.

questions.question: When do Spring 2026 classes start?
questions.gold_answer: Spring 2026 classes start January 12, 2026.

questions.question: When do Spring 2027 classes start?
questions.gold_answer: Spring 2027 classes start January 11, 2027.

questions.question: When does Summer 2026 begin?
questions.gold_answer: Summer 2026 begins May 16, 2026.

questions.question: When does the Fall 2025 waitlist close?
questions.gold_answer: The Fall 2025 waitlist closes August 20, 2025 at 11:59 AM.

questions.question: When is the Fall 2026 tuition payment deadline?
questions.gold_answer: The Fall 2026 tuition payment deadline is August 3, 2026.

questions.question: When is Spring Break in 2026?
questions.gold_answer: Spring Break 2026 is March 8-14, 2026.

questions.question: When is Spring Break in 2027?
questions.gold_answer: Spring Break 2027 is March 7-13, 2027.

questions.question: When does Fall 2025 end?
questions.gold_answer: Fall 2025 ends December 14, 2025.

questions.question: What GPA is required for automatic first-year admission?
questions.gold_answer: A 2.75 GPA is required for automatic first-year admission.

questions.question: What GPA is required for conditional first-year admission?
questions.gold_answer: A GPA between 2.5 and 2.75 is required for conditional admission.

questions.question: What GPA is required for automatic transfer admission?
questions.gold_answer: A 2.0 GPA with 16 or more transferable credits is required.

questions.question: What transcripts do first-year applicants need?
questions.gold_answer: High school transcript, any post-secondary transcripts, and AP scores.

questions.question: What transcripts do transfer students need?
questions.gold_answer: All post-secondary transcripts, including military, CLEP, and AP.

questions.question: What are the priority application deadlines?
questions.gold_answer: Fall: March 1, Spring: October 1, Summer: March 1.

questions.question: How long do transcripts take to arrive?
questions.gold_answer: Transcripts typically take 7-10 business days to arrive.

questions.question: What is undergraduate tuition for 2025-2026?
questions.gold_answer: Undergraduate tuition is $302.84 per credit.

questions.question: What is graduate tuition?
questions.gold_answer: Graduate tuition is $555.28 per credit.

questions.question: What fees are charged per credit?
questions.gold_answer: Activity $4, Technology $14, Parking $13, and others.

questions.question: What is the senior citizen tuition rate?
questions.gold_answer: The senior citizen tuition rate is $58.30 per credit.

questions.question: When does Fall 2026 financial aid disbursement begin?
questions.gold_answer: Fall 2026 financial aid disbursement begins September 11, 2026.

questions.question: What does financial aid pay first?
questions.gold_answer: Financial aid is applied first to tuition, fees, and university charges.

questions.question: What is the North Star Promise Scholarship?
questions.gold_answer: It is a last-dollar scholarship covering remaining tuition and fees.

questions.question: What happens if I withdraw from all classes?
questions.gold_answer: A Return to Title IV calculation may require repayment.

questions.question: How do students register?
questions.gold_answer: Students register through eServices.

questions.question: What should students check before registering?
questions.gold_answer: DARs, holds, financial aid, placement, and advising.

questions.question: What is the add/drop policy?
questions.gold_answer: Students may add or drop courses during the published add/drop period.

questions.question: What is a withdrawal?
questions.gold_answer: A withdrawal results in a W grade and may affect financial aid.

questions.question: What delivery methods does Metro State offer?
questions.gold_answer: In-person, online asynchronous, online synchronous, hybrid, and HyFlex.

questions.question: What is HyFlex?
questions.gold_answer: Students may choose in-person, synchronous, or asynchronous attendance each session.

questions.question: When do Fall 2026 visiting students register?
questions.gold_answer: Fall 2026 visiting student registration opens June 8, 2026.

questions.question: What is graduation?
questions.gold_answer: Graduation is the official confirmation of completing degree requirements.

questions.question: What is commencement?
questions.gold_answer: Commencement is a ceremonial event and does not confirm degree completion.

questions.question: When is Fall 2025 Commencement?
questions.gold_answer: Fall 2025 Commencement is December 15, 2025.

questions.question: What are the honors GPA thresholds?
questions.gold_answer: Summa Cum Laude 3.900 or higher, Magna Cum Laude 3.800-3.899, Cum Laude 3.700-3.799.

questions.question: How long until diplomas arrive?
questions.gold_answer: Diplomas arrive 8-10 weeks after degree posting.

questions.question: How long do students have to file a grade appeal?
questions.gold_answer: Students have 60 days after grades are posted to file a grade appeal.

questions.question: What is required to change a grade?
questions.gold_answer: Clear and convincing proof of arbitrary or capricious evaluation.

questions.question: What is academic integrity?
questions.gold_answer: Academic integrity means upholding honesty and acknowledging sources.

questions.question: What happens if a student violates academic integrity?
questions.gold_answer: Sanctions are applied and recorded.

questions.question: What is FERPA?
questions.gold_answer: FERPA is a federal law protecting student education records.

questions.question: How does Metro State evaluate transfer credits?
questions.gold_answer: Based on quality, comparability, and applicability.

questions.question: Does Metro State accept MnTC?
questions.gold_answer: Yes, Metro State accepts MnTC goal areas or the full MnTC.

questions.question: Who decides if transfer courses apply to a major?
questions.gold_answer: The academic department decides applicability.

questions.question: What does academic advising help with?
questions.gold_answer: Degree planning, DARs, and course selection.

questions.question: What does the Writing Center help with?
questions.gold_answer: Essays, research papers, and writing assignments.

questions.question: How do students request accommodations?
questions.gold_answer: Through the Center for Accessibility Resources.

questions.question: What does Career Services offer?
questions.gold_answer: Resume help, job search support, interview prep, and internships.

questions.question: Who helps with financial aid, registration, and billing?
questions.gold_answer: Gateway Student Services.
